scope: Proof, numerical and test controls only; no player-visible design choices.
physical_scale: mq20 unchanged; clays at native 1:1, old art at exact 4x
test_fixture: tests/test_mq24_maquette.py FIXTURE_DEFAULTS; explicitly injected, never used by official proof
measurement: contract.json measurement controls; inherited topology; 1e-6 H positional, 0.0001 H metric and 0.1 degree angle tolerances
regeneration: fresh copied source, no native model or cache copied
forearm_frame: Length runs elbow to wrist; body-backward normal projected perpendicular to length; near normal faces the fixed upper ring arc.
finger_roots: Sample the curved distal ellipse at the prescribed lateral coordinates; this attaches fingers to the palm instead of floating tubes beyond its pole.
near_thumb_fallback: If bounded articulation cannot reach, preserve exact total length with equal links at the maximum allowed curls and report failed contact.
capture_batches: One clay, parts or facing/silhouette pass per job; four solos per job with no redundant facing/parts renders. No renderer settings or timeouts changed.
mesh_face_comparison: Compare oriented cycles against pinned source; for opened native meshes derive Blender's existing outward-normal bake from the pinned source signed volume. The inherited sabaton loft is left-handed. Never infer expected winding from the live candidate.
mantle_facets: Recover the first interior upper-arm ring as shoulder support; project active columns onto the physical iron envelope. Use a conservative half-thickness offset correction for facets that cut convex joints. Hold all Z, neckline and hem-root positions fixed; only internal rows and tongue-tip XY may move. Independently probe all skin vertices and face centres.
fist_candidate_order: Maximum signed upper-loop crossings, then least normalized axial/roll motion from the director preferred pose. Zero contained candidates means no accepted pose; retain the preferred diagnostic.
near_thumb_solve: Sample the nearest middle segment surface and root angle, solve a two-link chain of total 0.045 H analytically, prefer balanced segment lengths, then a midpoint contact. Use the actual faceted surface; no dimensions, joint limits or clearances are relaxed.
mantle_native_normals: Derive the unchanged Blender normal bake from pinned round-1 shell adjacency and signed volume; source hem-rim winding is inconsistent with the skin. No live candidate winding is adopted.

independent_pose_audit.method: Recovered live closed disks, polygon parity, signed wire crossings; no constructor inequalities or diagnostics.

surface_distance.method: Exact triangle vertex, interior-edge and segment/face distance; conservative AABB pruning.

native_capture_gate.pixel_mapping: floor projected coordinate to its containing native pixel; existing pixel-centre triangle sampler locates ring/chain regions
native_capture_gate.ownership: existing native backend nearest sRGB label decoder, intersected with native lantern solo alpha
native_capture_gate.top_bar: Director feedback 1: inside native hand alpha, or no more than 8 px above native silhouette top at 1088 px.
native_capture_gate.below_fist: Director feedback 1–2: the lower grip ring, held_chain and lantern_cap_ring union lies below each occupied column's lowest hand pixel; every occupied column required.
